professionalSummary: Experienced product manager with a proven track record in owning and prioritising alert‑review workflow roadmaps, driving release reviews, and improving alert closure rates within service‑level targets.
experienceHighlights: Owned the alert‑review workflow roadmap, prioritising backlog each sprint with compliance operations and publishing to the compliance director.
Ran six release reviews with engineering and compliance operations, recording decisions and open items.
Increased alerts closed within target from 71% to 88% over four months post alert‑grouping release, exceeding the documented baseline.
Coordinated release schedules with engineering manager and compliance operations lead, ensuring timely rollout to analyst teams.
Authored release notes detailing known limitations and hand‑over conditions for analyst trainers.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Compliance operations monthly report extract showing alerts closed within target per month, baseline line, and alert‑grouping release marker; release record for the alert‑grouping release as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work samples, and notes establish the candidate’s ownership of the alert‑review workflow roadmap, execution of release reviews, improvement in alert closure rates, coordination with engineering and compliance operations, and documentation of release notes. They do not provide evidence of broader product strategy beyond the alert‑review workflow, nor of experience with other product areas or cross‑functional teams outside the described scope.

evidence.text: Owned the alert-review workflow roadmap for the transaction monitoring product, prioritising the backlog each sprint with the compliance operations lead and publishing the roadmap to the compliance director.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of ownership and prioritisation.

evidence.text: Ran the release review for each of the six workflow releases with engineering and compliance operations, recording decisions and open items in the release record.
evidence.notes: Explicit mention of release reviews and recording decisions.

evidence.text: The share of alerts closed within the service-level target rose from 71 percent to 88 percent over the four months after the alert-grouping release, per the compliance operations monthly report against its documented baseline of 71 percent.

Coordinated releases with the engineering manager and the compliance operations lead; the engineering manager set release dates and the compliance operations lead approved the rollout to analyst teams.
Wrote the release notes for each workflow release, including the known limitation that grouped alerts could not be split back into individual alerts, and the hand-over notes for analyst trainers.
